TRUMP’S THANKSGIVING MESSAGE TARGETS ECONOMIC DATA, IMMIGRATION AND POLITICAL OPPONENTS

President Donald Trump addressed economic data, immigration policy and political opponents in a lengthy Thanksgiving message.

Trump called for an investigation into the revision of Q3 GDP growth from 3.4% to 4.3%, describing it as a “RECORD SETTING ERROR.”

He also criticized progressive policies and made disputed claims about Somali immigrants in Minnesota, including calling for some to be “thrown out, immediately.”

Defending renovations to the White House, Trump said the building “has never looked better.”

The president concluded by reiterating his immigration enforcement priorities while extending Thanksgiving greetings.
(@WalterBloomberg)
